notes.title: Full Chinese version of Knell of St. Godhrkar is completed!
notes.notes:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
We are trilled to announce that the full Chinese version of Knell of St. Godhrkar is expected to be released in 5th-12th, December, 2021. We are looking forward for you to add to your wish list XD

This is a multi-protagonist POV story, where 7 main characters' fate are intertwined. You will peek into their life and work out the best result step by step.

The full version is expected to take 15-25 hours, with 29 bad endings and an authentic ending. Full scripts in Chinese is about 450k, with 3000+ storyboards and 56 voice actors. It will be available in Chinese, and we are currently working on the chapter 3's translation.
This game is completely Free, no ads, no in-house purchases, only the possibility of various BUGs. Welcome to feedback here!

Thank you all, for this long-term waiting, and also thank you for trying this game.
Thank you for loving this game.

notes.title: English Version Pretest Updated
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that the English version of Day 5 and 6 will be in this patch now along with the following chapters in the future updates .
You can download Knell of St. Godhrkar Demo to enjoy the new version. Go for "Language" in "Preferences" if it's still Chinese you see on the screen:-)

Special thanks to: Angelica Dahurica, MagicBread and Tim Yi whose effort made this happen.
Recently we are recruiting English editors and proofreaders. Please mail the producer Birctreel (andinomie@foxmail.com) if you are interested in joining us (and if you don't mind my limited budget for this is a free game).
